prompt: Use $apple-hig. Evaluate whether this product brief is supportable, then produce a feasible interface alternative. Avoid turning remembered platform details into guaranteed APIs. Read interface.md. write result.md with the concrete result, decisions, acceptance checks and what evidence is still missing.

input_files.interface.md: Brief: tvOS web view hosts a widget store using WidgetKit and a full browser. visionOS portal calls hypothetical AppleImmersionLock.disableDigitalCrown() to force full immersion. Team cites a 2019 blog post as proof. No Apple SDK is installed, API documentation is absent and current deployment requirements are undecided.

criteria.task_completion: Identify unsupported tvOS widget/web-view assumptions and unverified API, preserve a feasible native catalog/explicit immersion alternative with open deployment questions.
criteria.hig_correctness: Use source platform exclusions and system agency; treat historical material/hypothetical API as unverified rather than providing fabricated compilable calls.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Deliver a task-specific corrected artifact or evidence-grounded audit with worked states/transitions and observable checks; a generic checklist is insufficient.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Include exit and accessible input/legibility; qualify versions and leave runtime/build checks pending.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Do not invent native runtime results, unseen semantics, device support, measurements or source authority; distinguish source conflict and unresolved product constraints.

critical_errors: Presents the hypothetical API as real or guarantees it compiles.
Recommends widgets or web views as supported tvOS features.
Proposes disabling user control of immersion.
